events.title: Agent Standup adds local inspection of Codex sessions
events.title_zh: Agent Standup 增加 Codex 会话本地检查
events.summary: Agent Standup 1.27.0 adds read-only local inspection of Codex desktop and CLI session files alongside Claude Code sessions. Its VS Code, CLI and desktop views expose prompts, responses, commands, outputs, changed files, web and MCP calls, questions, reasoning summaries, token counts and turn endings. Codex subagents and images are not yet rendered.
events.summary_en: Agent Standup 1.27.0 adds read-only local inspection of Codex desktop and CLI session files alongside Claude Code sessions. Its VS Code, CLI and desktop views expose prompts, responses, commands, outputs, changed files, web and MCP calls, questions, reasoning summaries, token counts and turn endings. Codex subagents and images are not yet rendered.
events.summary_zh: Agent Standup 1.27.0 在 Claude Code 会话之外，增加对 Codex desktop 与 CLI 会话文件的只读本地检查。VS Code、CLI 和 desktop 界面可显示提示、回复、命令输出、改动文件、Web/MCP 调用、问题、推理摘要、token 计数与回合结束状态；暂不显示 Codex subagent 和图片。
events.why_it_matters: For teams reviewing agent work, a local timeline can expose commands and tool calls without uploading the session by default. The viewer can surface sensitive output, and exported video redaction is incomplete, so validate localhost isolation and secret handling before regular use.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams reviewing agent work, a local timeline can expose commands and tool calls without uploading the session by default. The viewer can surface sensitive output, and exported video redaction is incomplete, so validate localhost isolation and secret handling before regular use.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对需要复核 agent 工作的团队来说，本地时间线可以在默认不上传会话的前提下展示命令与工具调用。但界面会显示敏感输出，导出视频的遮挡也不完整，因此常规使用前要验证 localhost 隔离和密钥处理。

technical_details.surfaces: VS Code extension, npx launcher and standalone Node 18+ server
technical_details.codex_input: reads session files under ~/.codex/sessions without writing them
technical_details.visible_data: prompts, responses, commands, outputs, file changes, web/MCP calls, questions, reasoning summaries, token counts and turn endings
technical_details.privacy: default local English view binds to 127.0.0.1; optional translation, jokes, radio and usage counting may call external services
technical_details.limits: Codex subagents and images are not rendered; exported video redaction does not cover all spoken or quoted content; no independent accuracy or overhead benchmark

technical_details_zh.使用入口: VS Code extension、npx launcher 与独立 Node 18+ server
technical_details_zh.Codex 输入: 只读 ~/.codex/sessions 下的会话文件，不回写
technical_details_zh.可见数据: 提示、回复、命令输出、文件改动、Web/MCP 调用、问题、推理摘要、token 计数与回合结束状态
technical_details_zh.隐私: 默认英文/本地界面绑定 127.0.0.1；可选翻译、笑话、radio 与 usage counting 可能调用外部服务
technical_details_zh.限制: 暂不显示 Codex subagent 和图片；导出视频的遮挡不能覆盖所有口述或引用内容；没有独立准确率或开销 benchmark

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用非敏感 Codex 会话核对事件顺序、命令输出、token 计数、localhost 隔离与导出遮挡。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, use a non-sensitive Codex session to verify event order, command output, token counts, localhost isolation and export redaction.

evidence.claim_zh: Agent Standup 1.27.0 稳定版增加对 Codex desktop 与 CLI session 的本地只读展示。
evidence.claim_en: Agent Standup 1.27.0 stable adds local read-only rendering of Codex desktop and CLI sessions.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-release; display accuracy and privacy behavior not independently tested

changes.summary_zh: Agent Standup 增加 Codex 会话本地检查
changes.summary_en: Agent Standup adds local inspection of Codex sessions

events.title: Microsoft details Maia 300 before production deployments begin
events.title_zh: Microsoft 详解 Maia 300，生产部署将于 2027 年开始
events.summary: Microsoft disclosed Maia 300, a custom inference accelerator and rack system planned for production deployment from 2027. The company says a 96-accelerator rack should deliver 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems and up to seven times Maia 200 rack throughput. These are vendor projections; production telemetry and independent comparisons are not yet available.
events.summary_en: Microsoft disclosed Maia 300, a custom inference accelerator and rack system planned for production deployment from 2027. The company says a 96-accelerator rack should deliver 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems and up to seven times Maia 200 rack throughput. These are vendor projections; production telemetry and independent comparisons are not yet available.
events.summary_zh: Microsoft 公布 Maia 300 自研推理加速器与机架系统，计划从 2027 年开始生产部署。公司称 96 卡机架每兆瓦 token 产出比主流 GPU 系统高 40%，机架吞吐量最高是 Maia 200 的 7 倍。这些仍是厂商预测，尚无生产遥测或独立对比。
events.why_it_matters: For inference-platform teams, Maia 300 signals that hyperscalers are optimizing the whole rack around tokens per watt, not only chip peak performance. It is not deployable today, so procurement and capacity decisions should wait for workload-level throughput, latency, reliability and availability evidence.
events.why_it_matters_en: For inference-platform teams, Maia 300 signals that hyperscalers are optimizing the whole rack around tokens per watt, not only chip peak performance. It is not deployable today, so procurement and capacity decisions should wait for workload-level throughput, latency, reliability and availability evidence.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对推理平台团队来说，Maia 300 说明超大规模云厂商正在围绕每瓦 token 产出优化整套机架，而不只是追求芯片峰值性能。它目前还不能部署，采购和容量决策应等待真实工作负载的吞吐、延迟、可靠性与供给证据。

technical_details.availability: production deployments are planned to start in 2027; not currently deployed
technical_details.rack: 96 accelerators, 167 kW, 27.6 TB HBM and 1.7 PB/s aggregate memory bandwidth
technical_details.accelerator: TSMC N2P compute chiplets, eight HBM4 stacks, 288 GB HBM, 18 TB/s and 950 W
technical_details.vendor_claims: 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems; up to 7x Maia 200 rack throughput and more than 2.5x performance per watt
technical_details.numerics: MXFP4 and formats below three bits
technical_details.time_basis: official pages state 2026-10-12 without a time of day; inclusion follows the next complete daily window and does not claim hourly precision

technical_details_zh.可用性: 计划从 2027 年开始生产部署；当前尚未部署
technical_details_zh.机架: 96 个加速器、167 kW、27.6 TB HBM、1.7 PB/s 聚合内存带宽
technical_details_zh.加速器: TSMC N2P 计算 chiplet、八组 HBM4、288 GB HBM、18 TB/s、950 W
technical_details_zh.厂商声称: 每兆瓦 token 产出比主流 GPU 系统高 40%；机架吞吐最高为 Maia 200 的 7 倍，每瓦性能超过 2.5 倍
technical_details_zh.数值格式: MXFP4 与低于 3-bit 的格式
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方页面只标注 2026-10-12，没有时分；本轮按下一个完整日报窗口纳入，不声称通过逐小时边界核验

events.next_action_zh: 等 2027 年生产遥测与独立工作负载测试公开后，再比较吞吐、延迟、能效、可靠性和 Azure 供给。
events.next_action_en: Reassess after 2027 production telemetry and independent workload tests report throughput, latency, efficiency, reliability and Azure availability.

evidence.claim_zh: Microsoft 公布 Maia 300 架构与 2027 年生产部署计划；性能与能效数字均来自厂商。
evidence.claim_en: Microsoft disclosed the Maia 300 architecture and a 2027 production-deployment plan; performance and efficiency figures are vendor-reported.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; production and independent performance not yet available

changes.summary_zh: Microsoft 公布 Maia 300 架构，生产部署计划于 2027 年开始。
changes.summary_en: Microsoft disclosed the Maia 300 architecture, with production deployments planned from 2027.

events.title: StudentSim evaluates AI tutors with personalized learner simulations
events.title_zh: StudentSim 用个性化学习者模拟评测 AI 导师
events.summary: Microsoft Research released StudentSim, a framework that learns personalized student simulators from historical interactions and uses them to evaluate AI tutoring guidance. The paper studies 60 learners across chess, second-language learning and mathematics. The public repository includes the framework and chess data path, while other domains require separate data extraction and some evaluation paths require model API access.
events.summary_en: Microsoft Research released StudentSim, a framework that learns personalized student simulators from historical interactions and uses them to evaluate AI tutoring guidance. The paper studies 60 learners across chess, second-language learning and mathematics. The public repository includes the framework and chess data path, while other domains require separate data extraction and some evaluation paths require model API access.
events.summary_zh: Microsoft Research 发布 StudentSim：它从历史互动中学习个性化的学生模拟器，再用这些模拟器评测 AI 导师的指导。论文覆盖棋类、第二语言学习和数学三个领域，共 60 名学习者。公开仓库包含框架和棋类数据路径，其他领域要另行提取数据，部分评测还需要模型 API。
events.why_it_matters: For teams building tutoring systems, StudentSim offers a repeatable way to test whether advice adapts to one learner rather than only scoring generic answer quality. A simulator is still a proxy for a real student, so results do not establish learning outcomes or replace trials with learners and educators.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building tutoring systems, StudentSim offers a repeatable way to test whether advice adapts to one learner rather than only scoring generic answer quality. A simulator is still a proxy for a real student, so results do not establish learning outcomes or replace trials with learners and educators.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对开发 AI 导师的团队来说，StudentSim 提供了一种可重复的方法，用来检查建议是否真正适应某个学习者，而不只是回答得像标准答案。但模拟器只是学生的代理，结果不能证明真实学习效果，也不能替代学生与教师参与的试验。

technical_details.study_scope: 60 learners across chess, second-language learning and mathematics
technical_details.public_artifacts: MIT-licensed code and paper; repository ships a chess path, while language and math data require separate extraction
technical_details.author_result_example: chess personalized simulator fidelity 0.515 and responsiveness 0.9067; comparison values depend on the paper's setup
technical_details.limits: simulated behavior is a proxy, not a measured learning outcome; no deployment claim
technical_details.time_basis: research article feed timestamp 2026-10-12T16:00:00Z; paper first posted 2026-09-01

technical_details_zh.研究范围: 棋类、第二语言学习和数学三个领域，共 60 名学习者
technical_details_zh.指标: 行为保真度与指导响应度
technical_details_zh.公开材料: MIT 许可代码与论文；仓库直接提供棋类路径，语言和数学数据需要另行提取
technical_details_zh.作者结果示例: 棋类个性化模拟器的保真度为 0.515、响应度为 0.9067；比较结果依赖论文设定
technical_details_zh.限制: 模拟行为只是代理，不能当作真实学习效果；没有部署结论
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 研究文章 feed 时间为 2026-10-12T16:00:00Z；论文最早于 2026-09-01 发布

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用仓库自带棋类样本复跑 held-out 评测，核对保真度、响应度、API 依赖和真实学生结论边界。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, rerun the shipped chess held-out evaluation and check fidelity, responsiveness, API dependencies and the boundary to real-student outcomes.

evidence.claim_zh: Microsoft Research 公开 StudentSim 论文与代码，以 60 名学习者数据研究个性化模拟和导师评测。
evidence.claim_en: Microsoft Research published the StudentSim paper and code, studying personalized simulation and tutor evaluation with data from 60 learners.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-research-artifacts; outcomes are author-reported and simulator-based

changes.summary_zh: StudentSim 公开个性化学习者模拟与 AI 导师评测框架。
changes.summary_en: StudentSim publishes a framework for personalized learner simulation and AI-tutor evaluation.

events.title: ColGrep-Agent opens a local model for repository search
events.title_zh: ColGrep-Agent 开放本地代码库搜索模型
events.summary: LightOn released ColGrep-Agent, an Apache-2.0 local model and toolchain for searching repositories before a coding agent edits them. The model card reports five-seed localization tests on 300 instances per benchmark and an author study across 52 questions in 13 repositories. Public weights, code and integrations are available, but downstream patch success, total latency and compute have not been independently established.
events.summary_en: LightOn released ColGrep-Agent, an Apache-2.0 local model and toolchain for searching repositories before a coding agent edits them. The model card reports five-seed localization tests on 300 instances per benchmark and an author study across 52 questions in 13 repositories. Public weights, code and integrations are available, but downstream patch success, total latency and compute have not been independently established.
events.summary_zh: LightOn 发布 ColGrep-Agent：一个使用 Apache-2.0 许可的本地模型与工具链，在 coding agent 修改代码前先搜索仓库。模型卡报告了 5 个随机种子、每项 benchmark 300 个实例的定位测试，以及覆盖 13 个仓库、52 个问题的作者实验。权重、代码和集成已公开，但对最终补丁成功率、总延迟和算力的影响尚无独立结论。
events.why_it_matters: For coding-agent teams, a small local search specialist can reduce the source code sent to a frontier model and make repository context selection inspectable. Better file localization does not guarantee a correct patch, so evaluate end-to-end success and total resource cost rather than token savings alone.
events.why_it_matters_en: For coding-agent teams, a small local search specialist can reduce the source code sent to a frontier model and make repository context selection inspectable. Better file localization does not guarantee a correct patch, so evaluate end-to-end success and total resource cost rather than token savings alone.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding agent 团队来说，小型本地搜索模型可以减少发送给前沿模型的源码量，也让上下文选择更容易检查。但文件定位更准不等于补丁正确，应评测端到端成功率和总资源成本，而不只看 token 节省。

technical_details.availability: Apache-2.0 weights and code; integrations documented for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode
technical_details.localization_evaluation: five seeds and 300 instances per benchmark; author-reported SWE-bench Lite file F1 76.18 and line F1 19.92
technical_details.integration_study: author-reported 34.3% token reduction across 52 questions and 13 repositories
technical_details.runtime: Q8 package is approximately 2.5 GB; repository access is read-only during search
technical_details.limits: model name says 2B while the model card reports roughly 3B parameters; no independent end-to-end patch, latency or compute comparison
technical_details.time_basis: announcement gives 2026-10-12 without time of day; model repository was created 2026-10-03 and updated 2026-10-11

technical_details_zh.可用性: 权重和代码采用 Apache-2.0；文档提供 Claude Code、Codex 与 OpenCode 集成
technical_details_zh.定位评测: 5 个随机种子、每项 benchmark 300 个实例；作者报告 SWE-bench Lite 文件 F1 76.18、行 F1 19.92
technical_details_zh.集成实验: 作者报告在 13 个仓库、52 个问题上节省 34.3% token
technical_details_zh.运行要求: Q8 包约 2.5 GB；搜索期间只读访问仓库
technical_details_zh.限制: 模型名称写 2B，模型卡则显示约 3B 参数；没有独立端到端补丁、延迟或算力对比

events.next_action_zh: 一天内在代表性仓库比较检索召回、补丁成功率、token、端到端延迟和总算力。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, compare retrieval recall, patch success, tokens, end-to-end latency and total compute on a representative repository.

evidence.claim_zh: LightOn 公开 ColGrep-Agent 权重、代码、集成方法与作者评测。
evidence.claim_en: LightOn published ColGrep-Agent weights, code, integrations and author-run evaluations.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-artifacts; benchmark and integration results are author-reported

changes.summary_zh: ColGrep-Agent 公开本地代码库搜索权重、工具链与 agent 集成。
changes.summary_en: ColGrep-Agent publishes local repository-search weights, tooling and agent integrations.

events.title: Z.ai opens a limited beta for the GLM-Legal model
events.title_zh: Z.ai 开放 GLM-Legal 限量测试
events.summary: Z.ai announced GLM-Legal, a GLM-5.3-Flash-based model trained for legal analysis and document workflows. The company reports a 19.2% all-pass rate on Harvey LAB, with Harvey LAB and LegalBench results evaluated by Vals. Access is a limited beta through an application form, and AutoClaw support is described as coming soon; public weights and a generally callable API are not available.
events.summary_en: Z.ai announced GLM-Legal, a GLM-5.3-Flash-based model trained for legal analysis and document workflows. The company reports a 19.2% all-pass rate on Harvey LAB, with Harvey LAB and LegalBench results evaluated by Vals. Access is a limited beta through an application form, and AutoClaw support is described as coming soon; public weights and a generally callable API are not available.
events.summary_zh: Z.ai 公布 GLM-Legal：一款基于 GLM-5.3-Flash、面向法律分析和文档流程训练的模型。公司报告其在 Harvey LAB 的 all-pass rate 为 19.2%，并称 Harvey LAB 与 LegalBench 结果由 Vals 评测。当前只能申请限量测试，AutoClaw 支持仍是“即将推出”；没有公开权重或普遍可调用的 API。
events.why_it_matters: For legal-technology teams, an independently administered benchmark is stronger than a vendor-only score, but limited beta access prevents a normal engineering comparison and legal outputs remain high risk. The useful next signal is reproducible access plus citation, jurisdiction and document-editing error evidence.
events.why_it_matters_en: For legal-technology teams, an independently administered benchmark is stronger than a vendor-only score, but limited beta access prevents a normal engineering comparison and legal outputs remain high risk. The useful next signal is reproducible access plus citation, jurisdiction and document-editing error evidence.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对法律科技团队来说，由独立方执行 benchmark 比厂商自测更可信，但限量测试仍无法支持常规工程对比，法律输出本身也属于高风险。下一步应等可重复访问，以及引用、法域和文档修改错误的证据。

technical_details.training: specialized mid-training and reinforcement learning across legal environments
technical_details.vendor_result: Harvey LAB 19.2% all-pass, 12.5 percentage points above base
technical_details.independent_role: Z.ai states Vals evaluated Harvey LAB and LegalBench
technical_details.availability: application-only beta; AutoClaw integration coming soon; no public weights or generally available API
technical_details.time_basis: official page gives 2026-10-12 without time of day

technical_details_zh.训练: 法律语料 mid-training 与法律环境强化学习
technical_details_zh.厂商结果: Harvey LAB all-pass rate 19.2%，比基础模型高 12.5 个百分点
technical_details_zh.独立方角色: Z.ai 称 Harvey LAB 与 LegalBench 由 Vals 评测
technical_details_zh.可用性: 仅申请制 beta；AutoClaw 集成尚未推出；无公开权重或普遍可用 API
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方页面只标注 2026-10-12，没有时分

events.next_action_zh: 等待普遍可调用 API 或权重，并在引用、法域判断和 tracked changes 错误可独立复测后再评估。
events.next_action_en: Wait for a generally callable API or weights and independently reproducible citation, jurisdiction and tracked-change error tests before reassessing.

evidence.claim_zh: Z.ai 公布 GLM-Legal 的训练方法、benchmark 与申请制 beta，尚未提供公开权重或通用 API。
evidence.claim_en: Z.ai disclosed GLM-Legal's training, benchmarks and application-only beta without public weights or a generally available API.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-announcement; third-party benchmark administration stated by vendor

changes.summary_zh: Z.ai 公布 GLM-Legal 申请制 beta。
changes.summary_en: Z.ai announces an application-only GLM-Legal beta.

events.title: Agent37 launches a hosted sandbox service for AI agents
events.title_zh: Agent37 推出 AI agent 托管沙箱服务
events.summary: Agent37 launched through a founder-authored Hacker News post as a hosted sandbox service for running agents. The launch describes low-cost isolated environments, but the recall source alone does not provide sufficient independent security, reliability, pricing-stability or adoption evidence.
events.summary_en: Agent37 launched through a founder-authored Hacker News post as a hosted sandbox service for running agents. The launch describes low-cost isolated environments, but the recall source alone does not provide sufficient independent security, reliability, pricing-stability or adoption evidence.
events.summary_zh: Agent37 通过创始人撰写的 Hacker News 帖子发布，提供运行 agent 的托管沙箱。发布帖描述了低成本隔离环境，但单一社区来源不足以证明安全性、可靠性、价格稳定性或真实采用。
events.why_it_matters: Agent sandboxes are important, but a launch discussion without verifiable isolation tests or operating evidence should not drive infrastructure choice. Community attention is recorded, while investment is deferred.
events.why_it_matters_en: Agent sandboxes are important, but a launch discussion without verifiable isolation tests or operating evidence should not drive infrastructure choice. Community attention is recorded, while investment is deferred.
events.why_it_matters_zh: agent 沙箱很重要，但缺少可核验隔离测试和运行证据的发布讨论，不应驱动基础设施选择。记录社区热度，当前不投入。

technical_details.availability: hosted service described in founder launch post
technical_details.limits: no independently verified isolation, reliability, pricing stability or adoption

technical_details_zh.可用性: 创始人发布帖描述的托管服务
technical_details_zh.限制: 没有独立核验的隔离、可靠性、价格稳定性或采用证据

events.next_action_zh: 当前不投入；等公开隔离测试、可靠性记录和独立用户案例后再评估。
events.next_action_en: Do not invest now; reassess after public isolation tests, reliability history and independent user cases.

evidence.claim_zh: 创始人发布帖说明 Agent37 提供托管 agent 沙箱；缺少独立验证。
evidence.claim_en: The founder launch post describes Agent37 as a hosted agent sandbox service; independent validation is absent.

changes.summary_zh: Agent37 发布托管 agent 沙箱服务。
changes.summary_en: Agent37 launches a hosted agent sandbox service.
